This is a general tip, but I've always called for jungle and not many people would fight over it. Same with Support, except when there are duos, which are almost frequent. And jungle is, imo, the best position because you're a flex hero. You're everywhere. You know how the team loses and blames the jungler? And if you win, they'd always not say anything to your credit even if you did so freaking well helping the other lanes.

The best option is to choose your "best" role, tell people about it, and at least make a flex pick if some hardheaded dude just doesn't respect your openness for choosing your role. By flex pick, at least know one champion that can do two roles. If not, at least know one or two champions for each role. This counters pricks for not respecting other people's choices or what you're really good at.

There is no best hero for each role, and I'd suggest you don't pick heroes that are currently overpowered or "the cream of the crop" because they'll be nerfed in the coming patches (Runeglaive Ezreal, recently nerfed), and you'd scramble looking for another "main" or have a hard time if you're dependent on the power.

Current heroes I like from your pool:

  • Mid: Ahri (high skillcap from high mana cost but really decent overall and initiation is immensely great)

  • ADC: Sivir (use your ulti wisely, it really wins games)

  • Top: Lulu (good utility champ if you're team looks like you need it, practically has 7 different abilities), Rumble (high skillcap and a decent choice for a long time)

  • Support: Lulu (you don't have much support heroes, so I'd suggest you look for other better choices; Lulu's good, but not that good enough as a support in solo queue)

  • Jungle: Vi, Gragas (both have good utility)

If you're looking for better heroes, /u/sqnc has mentioned some.

Honestly i wouldnt try and main support depending on your elo its the hardest postion to carry the game cause you are reliant on the adc. in higher elo is fine cause everyone kinda knows what they are doing but bronze to silver i would just stick to jungle the vi zac gragas is a large enough pool to main jungle all of them have good ganks, jungle clear without the csing issues of the lanes. Camp the lanes that you think are going to tilt and keep jungle presence the enemy lanes need to be scared of overextending in fear of ganks if you afk in jungle they will run all over your lanes. Remember to take scuttles after you secure both buffs, dragon and helping take towers is as important as ganks. Final note your team might flame you but dont do anything stupid you dont need to tower dive pushing people out of lane and smacking the tower a couple of times is as good as kills. Warning jungles tend to fall behind in cs so make sure you go and take all the camps you can when you are able to. Happy elo climbing
